title: GPT-style Decoder
description: Autoregressive decoder-only transformer model for generative text.
name: GPT-style Decoder
summary: GPT-style Decoder models utilize masked self-attention to prevent looking at future tokens, training autoregressively to predict the next token in a sequence given the history.
use_when: Generating text, producing dialogue responses, or solving creative generation tasks.
avoid_when: Extracting features, classification, or embedding retrieval tasks where bi-directional context is preferred.
pros: Unrivaled performance on generative text and open-ended conversation tasks.
Can perform few-shot and zero-shot reasoning tasks without fine-tuning.
Unified output structure (everything is text generation).
cons: Computationally expensive inference due to autoregressive key-value cache building.
Prone to hallucinating factual errors or generating inconsistent reasoning.
Unidirectional restriction limits representation learning for bidirectional retrieval.

key_hyperparams.name: temperature
key_hyperparams.note: Controls the randomness of text generation. Smaller values make predictions more deterministic.

quick_start:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
import torch

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('gpt2')
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('gpt2')
inputs = tokenizer("The future of AI is", return_tensors="pt")
outputs = model.generate(**inputs, max_length=15)
